newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea to supply 500 bln won to banks.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea to supply 500 bln won to banks.

text.p: The central Bank of Korea said on Wednesday it has decided to release 500 billion won to the banking system through overnight repurchase agreements (Repos) to help relieve liquidity shortage.
A central bank official said the decision was made to help local banks meet their twice-a-month won reserve requirement due on Wednesday.
"This is unlikely to have a big impact on the market as it was largely expected," said a dealer at Hyundai Securities.
The repos will mature on Thursday.
